notes.title: The 'Big AD' Update
notes.content:
Hi All,

I've just dropped a big update to the Play Test build here on Steam with new features and the brand new look! As part of the games flow, if you're lingering at the bottom of the leader board this is going to impact your progress. Points allow you to not only move up the board, but also progress in a season with elimination points now kicking in at heat 4.

Here's some of the highlights in the update:

 New look and feel
 New Shop system that has main weapon upgrades
 New 'Homing Laser Missiles' that can be upgraded to second rapid shot
 New Shop items, Health increase, Stamina boos and Jet Boots upgrades
 New Shield item added to Item Drop zones
 Updated Slam Dunk function with shield and bigger hit range
 Update Arenas - Playing Fields / Crucible
 Reordered heats to follow on from each other within the same Arena (1-3 in Playing Fields, 4 - 6 in Crucible)
 Music volume control added to settings
Elimination points resulting in season knock outs
Balance of ammo clips based on level of main weapon
Cosmetic tweaks to end heat victory and arena 2 environment changes
Know Issue - Music volume is not being respected when a race begins.


I'm still getting around to updating any footage with the new AD but some new screen shots have been popped in. 

As always, keep on running!
